title: Tour DeVine by Heli
specs: Fly over picturesque vineyards and rolling hills in Willamette Valley
Taste a broad variety of Oregon wines including Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and others
Tours cover multiple AVAs including McMinnville, Eola-Amity Hills, Chehalem Mountains, Dundee Hills, Ribbon Ridge, and Yamhill-Carlton
Recommended group size is 4; can fit up to 5 or 6 if under weight limit
Can accommodate up to 4 groups per day; larger parties split into separate flights
includes: Pre-flight breakfast bites and sparkling wine
Gourmet picnic lunch provided by Red Hills Market
blurb: Guests enjoy helicopter rides to multiple wineries in the Willamette Valley, tasting a variety of wines including Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. Tours include gourmet food such as breakfast bites and a picnic lunch. The experience includes scenic flights, wine tastings, and a VIP service from start to finish.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled at least 48 hours before flight date · Cancellation fee if less than 48 hours notice · Refund or reschedule if weather cancels tour before it begins · Tour begins at airport hangar, 3800 NE Three Mile Lane, McMinnville, OR 97128 · May to October, operating Thursday, Friday, and Saturday
